title: Orby
description: this mod adds a cute mob that drops a lot of XP.
body:
![Orby](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c801e2aa2b35f1034ac4d8a74c799e82735413d_0.webp)

this mod adds a cute mob that 
drops a lot of XP.

This mob is called orby, orby spawns in every biome in overworld and is a rare mob.

If you liked the mod, you can check out my other one — Copper Amulets.
